title: Great job on cooking rice.  Attractive design.
text:
Great job on cooking rice. Attractive design.. It took approximately 30 minutes for 3 cups of white rice to cook. This was the first time I cooked in it.

Pros: It did a great job of cooking the rice.
Nice modern design. Love the color. It looks great on the counter top.
I love that I can cook other items in the cooker.
It has selections for: Porridge, STS( what is that?) Oatmeal, Soup, Steam, Stew, Slow Cook and Cake. which I have not tried yet, but I'm looking forward to trying.

Cons: When you open the lid after cooking, water flows down from the top due to the steam that was collected. It wasn't a huge mess but it was messy.

product_metadata.title: Aroma Housewares ARC-6106 Aroma Professional 6 Cups Uncooked Rice, Slow Cooker, Food Steamer, MultiCooker, Champagne
features: 11 MULTICOOKER MODES: The best rice cookers do it all: cook up to 6 cups of raw rice, Sauté-then-Simmer, slow cook, stew, steam, and more. Oatmeal, cake, or porridge? Yes!
BONUS STEAM TRAY: Steam meat, veggies, eggs, and more for healthy, delicious one-pot meals. This digital slow cooker and rice cooker doubles as a foolproof food steamer.
COOK ON YOUR SCHEDULE: Prep meals up to 15 hours early with an easy-to-program delay timer. In a rush? Use Aroma’s Quick Rice setting to cook white rice up to 50% faster.
MODERN DESIGN: This neutral, champagne-colored digital rice cooker has a low-profile shape that fits under kitchen cabinets, and the built-in handle makes it easy to move.
12-CUP FAMILY SIZE: Aroma’s large rice cooker is perfect for 4 to 10 portions, and it comes with a heavy-duty, wear-resistant pot. Just add rice, rinse, and pour water up to the line!
Perfectly prepares 4 to 12 cups of any variety of cooked rice. Power Consumption- 120V/60Hz 600W
Steams meat and vegetables while rice cooks below
Easy-to-use, programmable digital controls with automatic Keep-Warm and White Rice, Brown Rice, Quick Rice, Steam, Cake, Porridge, Oatmeal, Soup, Stew and Slow Cook functions
Sauté-Then-Simmé function provides high heat sautéing the automatically switches to simmer once liquid is added
15- hour Delay Timer for flexible meal planning
description: Aroma® professional 12-Cup rice cooker, Multicenter and food steamer makes cooking soft, fluffy rice with minimal effort. Cooking perfect rice with the moistness and texture that you would expect by a simple touch of a button and keeping rice warm just in time for serving mealtime. Whether long, Medium or short grain, this cooker is specially calibrated to cook all varieties of rice and whole grains, even tough-to-cook Brown rice. Versatile and easy to use, your aroma rice cooker can steam at the same time while cooking rice below.
